title: AJ Styles vs. Dixie Carter: the disputed champion
summary: AJ Styles defies Dixie Carter and wins the championship despite her opposition. His departure with the belt produces rival claims, ending in a heavily stacked unification match with Magnus.

chapters.title: Styles beats the champion and the odds
chapters.result: AJ Styles defeats Bully Ray to win the TNA world title.
chapters.context: Dixie’s interference cannot prevent the challenger from reclaiming the championship. His conflict with management now extends to possession of the belt.

chapters.title: Magnus becomes undisputed champion
chapters.result: Magnus defeats Styles in the title-unification match.
chapters.context: Repeated interference overwhelms Styles as Dixie’s chosen champion prevails. This television match closes Styles’ TNA championship chapter.
